text:
Digital Banking Platform
Secure microservices for everyday banking
Case Study | September 2026
textPreview: Digital Banking Platform | Secure microservices for everyday banking | Case Study | September 2026

alt: Editorial illustration of secure digital banking with a bank card, mobile application, and connected network

text: Source: prestigecontent.pdf supplied by the user. Cover slide based on the supplied Oracle case-study template.
One platform connects the public website, secure customer banking, reliable transfers, live notifications, and approved AI assistance.
textPreview: One platform connects the public website, secure customer banking, reliable transfers, live notifications, and approved AI assistance.

text:
React and TypeScript deliver the customer experience.
Spring Boot microservices separate identity, customer, transfer, content, chatbot, and notification responsibilities.
Oracle Database stores banking records while Kafka carries completed-transfer events.
textPreview: React and TypeScript deliver the customer experience. | Spring Boot microservices separate identity, customer, transfer, content, chatbot...

text: Source: prestigecontent.pdf supplied by the user.
JWT access control and Eureka-based discovery connect each layer. Domain services remain independently deployable and own focused business responsibilities.
textPreview: JWT access control and Eureka-based discovery connect each layer. Domain services remain independently deployable and own focused busines...

text: Source: prestigecontent.pdf supplied by the user.
A responsive React application introduces the bank and guides customers to secure sign-in.
textPreview: A responsive React application introduces the bank and guides customers to secure sign-in.

text:
Public routes cover Home, About Us, Investors, Offers, Contact Us, and Login.
The sticky navigation and responsive layout keep key actions accessible across screen sizes.
All deployed routes use the /bankdash prefix.
textPreview: Public routes cover Home, About Us, Investors, Offers, Contact Us, and Login. | The sticky navigation and responsive layout keep key acti...

text: Material UI, React Router, Axios, Swiper, lazy loading, and route animations form the frontend foundation.
textPreview: Material UI, React Router, Axios, Swiper, lazy loading, and route animations form the frontend foundation.

text: Source: prestigecontent.pdf supplied by the user.

Promise.allSettled keeps available sections visible when one request fails.
Offers appear in a responsive carousel, while investor updates support cards or rotating testimonials.
A shared page component changes its API request and layout for About Us, Investors, Offers, and Contact Us.
The service returns active content only, ordered for display and wrapped in a consistent response format.
textPreview: Promise.allSettled keeps available sections visible when one request fails. | Offers appear in a responsive carousel, while investor upda...

text: Source: prestigecontent.pdf supplied by the user.
Each microservice follows the same layered request path.
textPreview: Each microservice follows the same layered request path.

text:
DTOs separate external contracts from database entities.
Global exception handling returns predictable error responses.
textPreview: DTOs separate external contracts from database entities. | Global exception handling returns predictable error responses.

text:
Eureka enables discovery across independently running services.
Each service owns a focused business capability and data access path.
textPreview: Eureka enables discovery across independently running services. | Each service owns a focused business capability and data access path.

text: Source: prestigecontent.pdf supplied by the user.

Routes protected and public requests from one endpoint.
Controls CORS before traffic reaches domain services.
textPreview: Routes protected and public requests from one endpoint. | Controls CORS before traffic reaches domain services.

text:
Validates JWTs for customer-specific routes.
Passes verified identity context to the target service.
textPreview: Validates JWTs for customer-specific routes. | Passes verified identity context to the target service.

text: Source: prestigecontent.pdf supplied by the user.

Access tokens stay in application memory while secure browser cookies support session refresh.
The frontend retries a protected request once after a successful token refresh.
Refresh-token rotation, logout, password updates, and JSON Web Key Set endpoints support the full identity lifecycle.
Protected routes redirect unauthenticated customers to Login.
textPreview: Access tokens stay in application memory while secure browser cookies support session refresh. | The frontend retries a protected request...

text: Source: prestigecontent.pdf supplied by the user.

Loads the authenticated customer's profile, addresses, accounts, balances, and cards.
Uses the JWT customer ID to enforce ownership on every protected request.
Returns customer-specific JSON through DTO-based APIs.
textPreview: Loads the authenticated customer's profile, addresses, accounts, balances, and cards. | Uses the JWT customer ID to enforce ownership on ...

text:
Presents balance and transaction context required by the dashboard.
Supports secure card status changes and other sensitive operations.
Keeps entity models behind service and repository boundaries.
textPreview: Presents balance and transaction context required by the dashboard. | Supports secure card status changes and other sensitive operations....

text: Source: prestigecontent.pdf supplied by the user.
The dashboard assembles customer data from focused services without exposing service boundaries to the customer.
textPreview: The dashboard assembles customer data from focused services without exposing service boundaries to the customer.

text:
Navigation covers dashboard, accounts, cards, transfers, transaction history, notifications, and profile settings.
The experience supports responsive layouts, light and dark themes, and reduced-motion preferences.
textPreview: Navigation covers dashboard, accounts, cards, transfers, transaction history, notifications, and profile settings. | The experience suppo...

text: Source: prestigecontent.pdf supplied by the user.

Sensitive actions require authenticated ownership checks before account or card state changes.
Password visibility controls, inline validation, secure reset flows, and protected routes reduce common interaction risks.
Card controls remain separate from general profile updates so high-risk operations receive focused validation.
textPreview: Sensitive actions require authenticated ownership checks before account or card state changes. | Password visibility controls, inline val...

text: Source: prestigecontent.pdf supplied by the user.

The service checks account status, beneficiary name and IFSC, transaction password, transfer limit, available balance, and the minimum-balance rule.
Database-level locks protect both accounts from concurrent balance-update conflicts.
A completed transfer receives a unique reference and creates debit and credit records for account history.
textPreview: The service checks account status, beneficiary name and IFSC, transaction password, transfer limit, available balance, and the minimum-ba...

text: Source: prestigecontent.pdf supplied by the user.
Repeated requests with the same idempotency key return the original result instead of moving funds twice.
textPreview: Repeated requests with the same idempotency key return the original result instead of moving funds twice.

text: A BCrypt-verified transaction password approves the transfer, and customers see only activity linked to their accounts.
textPreview: A BCrypt-verified transaction password approves the transfer, and customers see only activity linked to their accounts.

text: Completed records support balance history, monthly expenses, weekly deposits, withdrawals, and service metrics.
textPreview: Completed records support balance history, monthly expenses, weekly deposits, withdrawals, and service metrics.

text: Source: prestigecontent.pdf supplied by the user.
The transfer response does not wait for notification delivery.
textPreview: The transfer response does not wait for notification delivery.

text:
Notification Service consumes the Kafka event asynchronously.
It creates separate sender and receiver messages and pushes live updates through Server-Sent Events.
Oracle stores each notification so customers can retrieve the list and unread count later.
textPreview: Notification Service consumes the Kafka event asynchronously. | It creates separate sender and receiver messages and pushes live updates ...

text: Source: prestigecontent.pdf supplied by the user.

Account updates, transaction records, transfer details, and the notification event commit together.
The publisher checks pending records every second and marks an event published only after Kafka confirms delivery.
When Kafka is unavailable, the event remains in the outbox and can be retried.
textPreview: Account updates, transaction records, transfer details, and the notification event commit together. | The publisher checks pending record...

text: A completed transfer always retains the event required to notify customers.
textPreview: A completed transfer always retains the event required to notify customers.

text: Source: prestigecontent.pdf supplied by the user.

Retrieves approved banking knowledge before calling the AI model.
Uses the retrieved context to limit unsupported responses.
textPreview: Retrieves approved banking knowledge before calling the AI model. | Uses the retrieved context to limit unsupported responses.

text:
Requires an authenticated customer identity.
Stores conversation history and applies explicit safety rules.
textPreview: Requires an authenticated customer identity. | Stores conversation history and applies explicit safety rules.

text: Source: prestigecontent.pdf supplied by the user.

The API Gateway applies central routing, CORS control, and early JWT enforcement.
Authentication Service creates RSA-signed tokens and manages refresh rotation, logout, and password changes.
Customer, Transfer, Notification, and Chatbot Services validate the token and enforce data ownership with its customer ID.
Oracle Database persists banking, public content, chatbot, transfer, and notification records.
Kafka separates transfer processing from notification delivery for resilient asynchronous communication.
DTO-based APIs keep internal entity models and implementation details away from the frontend.

Prestige Banking combines a clear customer experience with service-level ownership, strong identity controls, reliable money movement, and event-driven communication.
